items.detail: ★ 原文全文：「各位同學好，10／28（三）上午的課需要調課，請同學至 moodle 投票調課的上課時間，會選最多同學可出席的時段上課。請在 10／11（日）23：59 之前完成投票，謝謝各位配合。」討論區連結：moodle.ncku.edu.tw/mod/forum/discuss.php?d=480787　【為什麼這封標紅，而且是今天唯一一封紅的】因為它是今天窗口內唯一一封「有明確截止時間、且不投票會對你產生實際後果」的信。後果不是扣分，是更麻煩的東西：老師說「會選最多同學可出席的時段」，意思是最終時段由投票結果決定——你沒投，就等於接受別人幫你選的時間，而那個時間很可能撞到你其他課或打工。這是一個「不行動也會產生結果」的決定，而不是一個可以略過的通知。　【為什麼現在做比較好】截止日是週日 23:59，看起來還有五天，但這類 Moodle 投票的典型失敗模式是「想等看清楚選項再投」然後整件事被週末吃掉。投票本身只要兩分鐘，現在做掉就不用再記得它。　【投票前要先確認的一件事】打開選項之後，先對照你自己 10/28（三）當天的其他時段有沒有課或排班再勾——因為這一票是在替你未來的某個下午或晚上做承諾。

items.detail: ★ 原文重點：這是一門 Capstone 專案課程，先講授 AI 基本知識與市場定位的思辨，再讓學生以 AI 輔助的專案式學習（Project-Based Learning），在授課老師帶領下參與籌辦本校 5 個高中 STEM 科學教育營隊，從課堂理論走向真實場域實踐。開課人數 60 人、2 學分、完成可獲「融合通識 2 學分」。登記期間：即日起至 2026 年 10 月 12 日（一）止。　【為什麼這封對你特別值得看一眼】三個理由疊在一起：①它是 2 學分的融合通識，不是零碎的講座時數，直接抵學分；②它的內容是「AI 輔助的專案式學習」——你本來就在做大學專題與自動化專案，這門課的產出物（營隊設計、教材、流程）和你已經在練的技能高度重疊，邊際成本比一般通識低很多；③「籌辦 5 個高中 STEM 營隊」是可以寫進履歷的具體經驗，而通識課通常給不了這種東西。　【為什麼標黃不標紅】因為它是「機會」不是「義務」，不登記不會有任何懲罰。但它有兩個收斂條件：10/12 截止、而且信裡明說「名額所剩不多」——60 人的課在開學第四週還在催登記，意思是名額正在被填滿，所以這件事的有效期可能比 10/12 更短。　【建議的判斷方式】只問一個問題：這學期你還有多少可支配的課外時間？Capstone 專案課的實際負荷通常大於 2 學分的帳面重量（要真的去辦營隊）。如果你本學期已經有程序控制＋工程數學＋日文（三）＋分組報告在跑，那它的真實成本是「每週多出半天到一天」。值得，但要睜著眼睛選。

items.kind: 需要動作：今天抽 10 分鐘把檔案全部下載存好（下載不等於做完，但現在不下載以後會找不到）
items.detail: ★ 原文清單（第一封 09:43）：Introduction to this course／Handouts & Course Videos (Ch. 1 & 2)／**Problem Set #1 with detailed solution**／Sec. 1.2, Prob. 10／**2023 版課本缺漏的 INTEGRATING FACTORS 一節**（含奇數題答案）／**2023 版課本缺漏的 REDUCTION OF ORDER 一節**（含奇數題答案）／Sum of sinusoidal functions at the same frequency／Ch. 2 章末習題（O'Neil 8e SI ed.）／**Problem Set #2 with detailed solution**。第二封 09:44 是老師的補充回應，針對 Sec. 1.2 Prob. 10 說明「有些同學可能不熟悉」的解法。　【這封信真正的重點不是「有新教材」】而是裡面有兩個東西很少見：①**Problem Set 直接附詳解**——這在工數課不常見，意味著你可以自己閉卷做、再逐步對解法，等於有一份免費的模擬考題庫；②**老師補上了課本 2023 版缺漏的兩節**（Integrating Factors 積分因子、Reduction of Order 降階法）。這兩節不是可有可無的補充：積分因子是解一階線性 ODE 的標準工具，降階法是處理二階 ODE 已知一個解時求第二解的方法——兩者都是期中考的核心技術。老師主動補檔，等於告訴你「課本缺的這兩節我會考」。　【為什麼現在就下載】Moodle 的檔案在學期中被換版、改名或移動是常態，而這批檔案的價值在期中考前兩週才會真正用到。今天花十分鐘下載分類存好，是對自己未來的一次很便宜的保險。　【一個可以順手做的連結】下面「成大重點」區列到課業輔導（10/5–12/31，週一至五 18:00–21:00，光復校區學生安全組二樓 6023 教室）**有工程數學**。如果 Problem Set 做到卡住，那是現成的去處，不用自己硬磕。

items.en: Saudi Arabia, Turkiye and Pakistan Activate the Mecca Pact's Collective-Defence Clause
items.zh: 中東版「北約第五條」首次實際啟動——沙烏地、土耳其、巴基斯坦三國合計約 140 萬現役兵力，波灣戰事若擴大，台灣的進口能源成本與海運保費會最先反映
items.summary: Saudi Arabia, Turkiye and Pakistan agreed in Riyadh on October 5 to activate the collective-defence clause of the Mecca Pact, the mutual-defence treaty signed on August 7, 2026, following Houthi missile attacks on Saudi territory in early September. Saudi Defence Minister Khalid bin Salman met Pakistani Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar and Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan; Islamabad said members would provide the agreed military forces and ensure their rapid deployment. The three states command roughly 1.4 million active troops and 3,400 aircraft. Saudi-backed Yemeni forces simultaneously retook the Red Sea port of Mocha with about 100 coalition jets in support.

items.en: Analysts Ask Whether Iran Is Charging a Toll for Passage Through the Strait of Hormuz
items.zh: 荷莫茲海峽可能被變相課「通行費」：台灣原油與天然氣幾乎全靠海運進口，這條線直接通到中油採購成本、電價與物價
items.summary: Analysts are questioning whether Iran is extracting payment to let tankers through the Strait of Hormuz, which carried about 20 percent of world oil and gas exports and some 125 large commercial vessels daily before the war began in February 2026. Kpler's head of policy, Michelle Brohard, speculated that Gulf states may be paying Iran 10 to 20 percent of their cargo, while stressing the claim is unverified. IRGC commander Ali Fadavi said only three to four million barrels a day move along US-supervised routes. Gulf exports reached 19.5 to 22.5 million bpd in late September, and Brent traded near $100 on October 5.

items.en: FBI Arrests California Woman Accused of Spying on the Taiwanese President's Son for China
items.zh: ★ 今天最該讀的一則：中國情蒐延伸到美國本土的台灣總統家屬，嫌犯在洛杉磯機場準備登機返中時被捕
items.summary: The FBI arrested Wanying Zhang, 34, also known as Heather, of Irvine, California, on Sunday at Los Angeles International Airport as she prepared to board a flight to China. She is charged with acting as an unregistered foreign agent. Prosecutors say Zhang travelled to Seattle in 2025 on behalf of Chinese officials and transmitted photographs, video and licence-plate information of Lai Ting-yu, the son of Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te, and his family to authorities in Beijing. Bill Essayli, first assistant US attorney for the Central District of California, said Zhang used tradecraft to avoid detection. She appeared in Los Angeles federal court on Monday.

items.en: Russian Drones Sink a Turkish-Owned Grain Ship Inside Romania's Economic Zone, Killing Two
items.zh: 北約成員國經濟海域內的商船被擊沉，黑海糧運與北約紅線同時被測試——全球糧價與台灣進口穀物成本的尾部風險
items.summary: A Turkish-owned grain carrier, the Royad Mammadov, caught fire and sank on October 5 inside Romania's exclusive economic zone in the Black Sea, killing two crew members; eleven others were rescued. Romania's coastguard was alerted at about 11am local time, and the interior ministry did not identify a cause. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy blamed a horrific strike by two Russian drones on a civilian vessel in neutral waters carrying corn and owned by Turkiye. The crew included Azerbaijani and Indian nationals. Romania is among several NATO members reporting incursions during 2026, after earlier drone strikes in May, June and July.

items.en: US Justice Department Launches Record Push to Strip Naturalised Americans of Citizenship
items.zh: 美國啟動現代史上最大規模的剝奪入籍公民身分行動，自八月底已提 40 起訴訟——對計畫赴美求學或工作的人是一條實質法律風險
items.summary: The US Justice Department has filed 40 lawsuits since late August seeking to strip naturalised Americans of citizenship, an effort Attorney General Todd Blanche called the largest denaturalisation push in modern history, according to reporting published October 6. Defendants come from Mexico, Pakistan, China, Sierra Leone and elsewhere, accused of money laundering, child sexual abuse, visa fraud, tax evasion and espionage. Denaturalisation requires proving an applicant concealed material facts that would have disqualified them, and became rare after the Cold War. Rights groups warn the cases risk leaving people stateless and say specific communities are being singled out.

items.en: OpenAI Unveils ChatGPT Watermarking as European Union AI Rules Take Effect
items.zh: OpenAI 推出隱形文字水印 textGrain 因應歐盟 AI 法規——但短文、數學內容與改寫過的文字仍可能測不出來，這正是它的限制所在
items.summary: OpenAI began rolling out textGrain, an invisible watermarking system, on Monday, October 5, 2026, in response to the EU AI Act's transparency rules requiring machine-readable marks on synthetic content. API developers worldwide can opt in immediately, while watermarking for ChatGPT and Codex users in the European Union follows over the coming weeks. textGrain embeds statistical patterns in word selection that a detector can later recognise, but OpenAI concedes reliability drops on short passages, mathematical content and heavily edited or paraphrased text. For now the detector is limited to vetted researchers and specialist organisations rather than the public; OpenAI says it plans to open-source textGrain.

items.en: TikTok Rolls Out an AI Shopping Assistant and One-Click Checkout
items.zh: TikTok 把 agentic commerce 搬進 App：對話式 AI 導購＋Buy Direct 一鍵結帳，直接在 For You 頁完成購買
items.summary: TikTok on Monday, October 5, 2026 launched an AI Shopping Assistant and a one-click Buy Direct checkout, pushing the app toward agentic commerce. The conversational assistant sits inside TikTok, remembering a user's preferences across a session and answering questions about product details, sizing, shipping and availability. Buy Direct lets shoppers complete purchases straight from the For You feed without leaving the app, with Salesforce, Shopify, Shoplazza and Stripe as launch partners. TikTok cited its Economic Impact Report showing 54 million Americans bought something after watching a video, and TikTok Shop generated roughly $15.8 billion in 2025 US sales, about 18 percent of social commerce.

items.en: SpaceX Scrubs Launch of 21 Data Transport Satellites for the Space Development Agency
items.zh: 獵鷹 9 號倒數最後一分鐘中止，21 顆太空發展署資料傳輸衛星改 10/6 自范登堡再試——順便對照今天信件區那封衛星競賽通知
items.summary: SpaceX aborted a Falcon 9 countdown in the final minute on October 4, 2026, scrubbing the T1TL-A mission carrying 21 data transport satellites for the US Space Force's Space Development Agency. The count stopped around 4:28 am EDT as the rocket entered its automated startup sequence, and no reason was given. The Northrop Grumman-built spacecraft belong to the Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture, a constellation built for missile tracking and secure military communications. SpaceX reset the attempt for Tuesday, October 6 at 1:17 am PDT from Vandenberg Space Force Base. Booster B1103 would be flying a sixth time, and success would mark the 668th Falcon booster landing.

items.en: Braves Even the NLDS With a 3-2 Win Over the Dodgers
items.zh: 勇士 3-2 力克道奇，國聯分區系列戰戰成 1-1；Harris II 三壘打＋二壘打包辦關鍵攻勢，道奇先發 Snell 只撐 3⅔ 局
items.summary: The Atlanta Braves beat the Los Angeles Dodgers 3-2 on Sunday, October 4, evening the National League Division Series at one game apiece. Michael Harris II drove the offence, tripling and scoring the go-ahead run on a wild pitch before adding an RBI double in the seventh. Dodgers starter Blake Snell lasted only 3 2/3 innings, allowing one run on three hits with five walks and five strikeouts over 90 pitches. Freddie Freeman homered in the fourth and Max Muncy added a two-out solo shot in the ninth, but Raisel Iglesias closed it out. Game 3 moves to Atlanta, Chris Sale facing Yoshinobu Yamamoto.

items.en: White Sox Hold On 4-3 to Take a 2-0 ALDS Lead Over the Guardians
items.zh: 白襪 4-3 再勝守護者、系列賽 2-0 聽牌；六局一口氣 3 分逆轉，守護者先發 Williams 飆 11K 仍吞敗
items.summary: The Chicago White Sox edged the Cleveland Guardians 4-3 on Monday, October 5, taking a 2-0 lead in their best-of-five American League Division Series. Trailing 2-1, Chicago scored three times in the sixth: Miguel Vargas singled to lead off, Braden Montgomery lined a go-ahead two-run double down the right-field line off reliever Erik Sabrowski, and Chase Meidroth added an RBI single. Guardians starter Gavin Williams struck out 11 over 5 2/3 innings on 98 pitches. Sean Burke gave Chicago 5 1/3 innings of one-hit bulk relief, and Grant Taylor recorded a four-out save despite Jo Adell's ninth-inning RBI triple.

items.en: Patriots Upset the Bills 29-26 in Buffalo Behind Drake Maye
items.zh: 愛國者客場 29-26 氣走比爾斯、送上本季首敗；Maye 傳 3 次達陣，Chism 單手 23 碼接球完成逆轉
items.summary: The New England Patriots upset the Buffalo Bills 29-26 in Buffalo on Sunday, October 4, improving to 2-2 and handing Buffalo its first loss of the 2026 season. Drake Maye completed 21 of 35 passes for 257 yards with three touchdowns and one interception, including two scoring throws to Romeo Doubs. Receiver Efton Chism made a spectacular one-handed 23-yard touchdown grab in the fourth quarter, and New England converted the ensuing two-point attempt to lead 29-26. Safety Craig Woodson sealed it by intercepting Josh Allen with 1:05 remaining. The result also gives the Patriots a head-to-head tiebreaker over the Bills.

items.en: Study of 2.5 Million Children Finds No Link Between the MMR Vaccine and Autism
items.zh: 256 萬名美國兒童健保資料：MMR 疫苗與自閉症無關聯，調整後風險比 0.97（99% CI 0.91–1.03）——這則的價值在統計檢定力，不在新奇
items.summary: A study published October 4 in The Pediatric Infectious Disease Journal analysed electronic health records for 2,560,035 US children who had routine primary care visits between 12 and 24 months of age, drawn from the Cosmos database. Using an age-anchored landmark design comparing children within the same vaccination age window, researchers Todd Burstain, Dale Jacques and Jennifer Burstain found an adjusted hazard ratio of 0.97 (99% CI 0.91-1.03) for autism among children vaccinated with MMR between 11.5 and 24 months, indicating no difference in risk. Autism prevalence in the cohort was 2.55 percent. Models adjusted for maternal age, gestational age, birth weight, pregnancy complications, neighbourhood disadvantage and region.

items.en: Early Neglect May Disrupt How the Brain Fine-Tunes Itself During Adolescence
items.zh: 163 名羅馬尼亞兒童追蹤到 23 歲的隨機對照研究：早期機構養育與青春期大腦「自我調校」方式的差異有關，且差距從 16 歲後變大
items.summary: Research published October 4 in Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences followed 163 Romanian young people from the randomised Bucharest Early Intervention Project: 52 placed into foster care, 51 who remained in institutional care, and 60 never-institutionalised community comparisons. Participants completed a Flanker attention and self-control task while EEG recorded brain activity at roughly ages 12.7, 16.9 and 23.3 years. Those with institutional histories showed consistently higher values on measures of neural stabilisation than never-institutionalised peers, and these neural differences explained part of the group gap in task performance, with the association strengthening from age 16 onward.

items.en: A Slew of New US Federal K-12 Policies and Guidance Lands in One Week
items.zh: 美國聯邦教育新政一週齊發：全國性學費稅額抵免提案出爐、撥款前要先「說明用途」、2024 年 Title IX 規定正式撤除
items.summary: K-12 Dive's October 5 policy review rounded up a burst of new federal K-12 action. The Treasury Department released its proposed rule on October 1 for the Education Freedom Tax Credit, the first nationwide federal school choice programme, created by the 2025 One Big Beautiful Bill. A September 28 Education Department memo will require grant recipients to submit written justification before drawing down pre-approved funds starting November 1, part of a defend-the-spend effort that education groups warn could delay money to schools. The department also formally struck the Biden administration's 2024 Title IX regulations, and issued joint guidance with the Justice Department on school swatting.

items.en: Pentagon Officially Removes Anthropic's Claude From Military Systems Months After Ban
items.zh: ★ 美國國防部確認全面停用 Claude：Anthropic 拒絕鬆綁「自主武器」與「大規模境內監控」的防護欄，代價是被列為國安供應鏈風險、預算轉向 OpenAI／xAI／Google
items.summary: A Pentagon official confirmed on Monday, October 5, 2026 that the US Department of Defense has stopped using Anthropic's Claude, completing a phaseout set in motion in February 2026 with a six-month removal deadline. The rupture followed Anthropic's refusal to loosen guardrails barring autonomous weapons and mass domestic surveillance; the Pentagon then designated the company a national security supply-chain risk, a label usually reserved for foreign adversaries, and Anthropic took legal action. Claude had been deeply embedded in Palantir's Maven Smart System, which processes drone footage and satellite imagery. Defence spending is shifting toward OpenAI, xAI and Google.

items.en: Google Downgrades Gemini Access for Users on Free and Budget Plans From October 9
items.zh: 10/9 起免費用戶只剩 Gemini 3.5-Flash-Lite、AI Plus（$4.99）失去 Pro 級推理模型——Google 明顯在為 Gemini 4「Argon」預留前沿算力
items.summary: Google is restructuring Gemini model access by subscription tier starting Thursday, October 9, 2026. Free users will be limited to Gemini 3.5-Flash-Lite, losing Gemini 3.6 Flash and newer models, while AI Plus subscribers at $4.99 a month are capped at Flash and Flash-Lite and lose Gemini 3.1-Pro and later reasoning models. AI Pro and Ultra subscribers keep their current access and gain a Deep Thinking option. Google is also adding low, medium and high effort levels, with usage allowances draining faster at higher settings. The changes appear to reserve frontier capacity ahead of expected launches of Gemini 4 Argon.

items.en: TSMC Earnings Preview: Terafab Talks, 2027 Price Hikes and the A14-vs-Intel-14A Race
items.zh: 台積電 10/15 法說五大看點：馬斯克證實洽談德州 Terafab、2027 先進製程擬漲價 5–10%／先進封裝 10–15%、A14 試產對決 Intel 14A
items.summary: TrendForce previewed TSMC's October 15, 2026 earnings call on Monday, flagging five themes. TSMC guided third-quarter revenue to $44.6-45.8 billion with gross margin of 65-67 percent, and 2026 capital spending of $60-64 billion. Reports point to 2027 price increases of 5-10 percent on advanced nodes, 10-15 percent on advanced packaging and 3-5 percent on mature nodes as AI demand strains capacity for Nvidia, Apple, AMD, Broadcom and MediaTek. Elon Musk confirmed talks with TSMC over his Terafab project in Texas, saying just discussions, but something may come of it. TSMC's A14 pilot production may begin in the first quarter of 2027.

items.en: YOASOBI's "Hajimete no" Anthology Gets a Paperback Edition With a Member-Photo Bookmark
items.zh: ★ 清單內最值得記的一條：YOASOBI **台北大巨蛋場次已定 2027/1/9–10**；原作小說集文庫版 10/6（今天）開賣、首刷附成員書籤可當周邊收藏
items.summary: The bunko paperback edition of Hajimete no, the anthology that produced four YOASOBI songs, went on sale October 6, 2026. Four Naoki Prize-winning authors each wrote an original story on the theme of doing something for the first time, which became Mister, Umi no Manimani, Seventeen and Suki da. The paperback prints each song's lyrics at the end of its chapter, and first pressings come with a bonus bookmark carrying member photos and comments. A linked novel, Senpai o Koroshitai no de Josou Suru, arrives October 16 with a new YOASOBI song KILLA attached. YOASOBI play Taipei Dome on January 9-10, 2027.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE's "POPS" Takes No.1 With 638,000 First-Week Copies as the SHADOWS Arena Tour Rolls On
items.zh: 第六張專輯《POPS》首週 63.8 萬張（Oricon 64.6 萬）登頂、連兩張破 50 萬；但「SHADOWS」巡演 13 城 28 場全在日本，目前沒有台北場
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE's sixth album POPS, released September 30, 2026, debuted at No.1 on Billboard Japan's album sales chart with 638,000 copies and on the Oricon weekly album chart with 646,000, their second straight album past 500,000 first-week units. The 16-track set pairs seven previously released songs with nine new ones, including Kyouhan, Cinderella, Hon to Suisei, A Posteriori and Episode. The band is simultaneously running Mrs. GREEN APPLE Ringo Jam Tour SHADOWS, its first arena tour in roughly three years, covering 13 cities and 28 performances from September 30 onward, all inside Japan.

items.en: Ado Reunites With B'z Guitarist Tak Matsumoto on TMG's "SAYONARA"
items.zh: Ado 參與 TMG（松本孝弘領軍）新曲〈SAYONARA〉MV 10/5 上線，專輯《TMG III SAYONARA》10/14 四種版本發售；巡演 10/5–10/23 僅日本場
items.summary: On October 5, 2026 TMG, the hard-rock unit led by B'z guitarist Tak Matsumoto, premiered the music video for SAYONARA, a collaboration featuring Ado and the October ending theme for TBS's Hiruobi. The song anchors TMG's third album TMG III SAYONARA, out October 14, 2026 in four editions: standard at 2,500 yen, a Blu-ray limited edition at 7,000 yen, a beanie-cap limited edition at 5,000 yen, and a fan-club version with acrylic stand at 4,000 yen. The six tracks also include DOOM and a Beatles cover. TMG LIVE 2026 SAYONARA runs across Japanese cities from October 5 through October 23.

items.en: Aimyon Sets New Digital Single "Sanagara Lonely" for October 12
items.zh: あいみょん新曲〈さながらロンリー〉10/12 數位發行、10/5 已於 FM802 首播；11/30–12/1 武道館，2027「cosmic %」巡演目前只公布日本場館
items.summary: Aimyon announced her new digital single Sanagara Lonely, out October 12, 2026, with its first full-length national radio airing on FM802's ROCK KIDS 802 on October 5. The track is the theme song for ABC and TV Asahi's Sunday 10:15pm drama Mou Papa, which premiered October 4. The artwork, art-directed by Hayabara Tonda, shows bright cherries and a single spider caught in a web against pale pink. It follows the four-disc AIMYON BEST ALBUM from September 9, and precedes Budokan shows on November 30 and December 1, 2026, plus the AIMYON TOUR 2027 cosmic percent arena run.

market.asOf: 台股＝前一交易日 2026/10/05（週一）13:30 收盤；美股＝2026/10/05（週一）收盤。★ 今天是週二，台股上午 9:00 已開盤（這一區不是即時報價）、美股要等台北時間今晚 21:30，所以顯示的是週一這個完整交易日的數字。　★★ 今天這一區的覆蓋率比昨天好非常多：昨天 75 檔只有 3 檔有漲跌幅資料，今天有 **42 檔**（台股 20 檔、美股 22 檔）；QQQ 昨天是空狀態，今天有真實收盤 756.20。
market.highlight: ★★★ 今天開盤前只要記住三件事：**①台股週一不是小漲，是暴漲 1,236 點（+2.55%）收 49,712，距離五萬點只剩 288 點**，而且這次成交金額放大到 1.15 兆元（前一交易日 9,332 億）、三大法人買超 764 億——昨天晨報才指出「逼近前高但量能縮減、屬於價到量沒到」，週一直接用放量 23% 回答了那個疑問。台積電收 2,575 元（+3.00%）創收盤天價，單檔貢獻了指數大部分漲點。**②你的清單第一次有 7 檔漲幅 ≥5%，全部集中在 AI 伺服器材料與機構件**：台光電、金像電、川湖、華通四檔漲停，創意 +8.86%、台達電 +6.37%、緯穎 +5.35%。這一輪是從上游材料推上來的（清單外的南亞 1303 漲停創歷史新高、電子材料占營收近六成）。**③美股同日那斯達克創歷史新高（27,477.31、+1.05%）、NVIDIA 創新高收 238.90（+2.12%），但十年期美債殖利率同時升到 5.315%、創 52 週新高。**　【這三件事怎麼一起讀】前兩件是同一條線：AI 需求把材料端的報價推上去，台股受益最深的不是「做 AI」的公司，是「賣材料給做 AI 的公司」。第三件是這條線的風險：殖利率衝到 5.3% 以上通常會壓抑成長股評價，而週一市場選擇忽略它（唯一收跌的是房地產）。這種「忽略」能撐多久，是接下來幾天真正要盯的事——不是指數會不會破五萬，而是殖利率會不會先把它拉回來。
market.note: ★ 今天四條主線：　①【台股：這次是真的放量突破】加權指數 49,712.04（+1,236.30 點、+2.55%），盤中最高 49,770.66，距五萬點 288 點。關鍵不是點數而是成交金額：1 兆 1,508 億元 vs 前一交易日 9,332 億元，放大約 23%，三大法人買超 764 億元，盤中千金股達 56 檔。昨天晨報引用富邦投顧的「價到量沒到、建議持股六成不追高」，這個判斷在週一被成交量推翻了——這不是說昨天的分析錯，是說「量能縮減」這個條件在一天之內消失了，而條件變了結論就要跟著變。　②【AI 材料是這一輪的主角，而且是從上游推上來的】高階 CCL 規格升級到 M9、AI 交換機由 800G 邁向 1.6T，帶動材料全面升級與缺貨漲價，缺貨行情被看到 2027 年。台光電 2383 漲停收 5,700 元、金像電 2368 漲停約 1,200 元（泰國廠擴產，季營收由 6 億拉升至 13 億）、川湖 2059 漲停收 13,355 元、華通 2313 漲停，清單外的台燿 6274、聯茂 6213、燿華 2367 同步漲停，上游南亞 1303 漲停創歷史新高。**這是族群性而非個股事件**，判斷依據就是「同一天、同一條供應鏈上下游同時漲停」。　③【美股：創新高，但背後有一個不協調的訊號】那斯達克綜合指數 27,477.31（+1.05%）與那斯達克 100 同創歷史新高，NVIDIA 收 238.90 美元（+2.12%）盤中最高 240.10 創新高、市值逼近 5.76 兆美元。併購題材同時熱絡（施耐德 226 億美元收購 PTC、PTC +33.49%；C.H. Robinson 58 億美元收購 RXO）。但十年期美債殖利率收在 5.315%、升 3.8 個基點、創 52 週新高，是 2002 年 4 月以來最高收盤——TheStreet 指出長端賣壓「不只來自貨幣政策，還有實質殖利率偏高、政府大量借款與資金競爭」。成長股在殖利率創高的同一天創新高，這兩件事長期不能並存。　④【一個乾淨的反面教材：聯電 2303】在大盤漲 2.55% 的日子逆勢跌 5.57%（ADR −9.95%），原因純粹是財務面：10/05 敲定 18 億美元海外可轉債的轉換價與溢價，兩個月內連續籌資，股權稀釋疑慮。你的清單裡沒有聯電，但這件事值得記住的理由是**它示範了「同一個產業標籤下，材料端漲停、成熟製程代工重挫」**——所以「半導體漲還是跌」這種問法在現在這個市場依然沒有意義。

indices.name: 加權指數 TAIEX
indices.note: 10/05（一）13:30 收盤 · **+1,236.30 點、+2.55%** · 集中市場成交金額 1 兆 1,508 億元（前一交易日 9,332 億元，放大約 23%）· 盤中最高 49,770.66 點，距五萬點僅約 288 點 · 三大法人買超 764 億元 · 盤中千金股達 56 檔。★ 這是「價量俱揚」而不是昨天那種「價到量沒到」——昨天的晨報才剛指出逼近前高但量能縮減、建議不追高，結果週一就用暴增 23% 的成交金額把那個疑問回答掉了。【已交叉確認：鏡新聞、經濟日報 UDN、中時、鉅亨、財報狗 TAIEX 頁】

movers.name: ⚠️ 先說清楚這一區今天的資料基準與一個重要變化
movers.price: 台股＋美股皆為 2026/10/05（一）收盤・當日全市場異動榜
movers.reason: ★ 和昨天最大的不同：**今天有 7 檔漲幅 ≥5% 的標的落在你的 75 檔觀察清單內**——這在過去一週是第一次。昨天那份名單裡「一檔都沒有」，今天一口氣七檔，而且全部集中在同一條線上：AI 伺服器的材料與機構件（高階 CCL／PCB／載板／滑軌）。這不是七個獨立事件，是一個族群同時被重新定價。　【清單內 ≥5%】台光電 2383 +9.93%（漲停）、金像電 2368 +9.95%（漲停）、川湖 2059 +9.96%（漲停）、華通 2313 漲停、創意 3443 +8.86%、台達電 2308 +6.37%、緯穎 6669 +5.35%。　【清單內需要警惕的一檔】清單裡沒有聯電 2303，但它當天 −5.57%、ADR 更跌 9.95%——原因是 10/05 正式敲定 18 億美元海外可轉債的轉換價與溢價（A 券 179.19 元／溢價 17.5%，B 券 202.06 元／溢價 32.5%，合計逾 550 億台幣），兩個月內連續籌資引發股權稀釋疑慮。這是一個乾淨的教材：同一天、同一個「半導體」標籤，材料端漲停、成熟製程代工卻因為財務操作重挫。

movers.name: PTC Inc.（清單外 · 當日最值得注意的一檔）
movers.reason: ★ 施耐德電機（Schneider Electric）宣布以每股 205 美元、總額 226 億美元**全現金**收購 PTC，溢價約 42.3%。PTC 是工業軟體（CAD／PLM，Creo、Windchill）大廠，這筆交易被市場讀成「工業 AI 整併加速」：硬體廠商直接買下設計與生命週期管理的軟體層。對化工／機械背景的人來說，這是你未來會用到的工具鏈正在被重組。

movers.name: XP Inc.（清單外 · 當日最大漲幅之一）
movers.reason: 巴西總統大選結果激勵巴西資產全面大漲：Bovespa 單日漲逾 8%、雷亞爾升值 4%。★ 這一條要搭配昨天晨報的頭條一起看——昨天寫「選前華爾街已經把巴西拆成兩套完全相反的劇本，今天開盤會給答案」，答案在 10/05 給了，而且是最極端的那一種。巴西對你的 75 檔清單幾乎零直接曝險，所以這是一則「驗證預期」而不是「要你行動」的新聞。

movers.name: RXO Inc.（清單外）
movers.reason: 成為 C.H. Robinson 的收購標的（58 億美元現金加股票），溢價約 29%。有趣的是買方 CHRW 同日 −10.85%——市場認為代價太高、整合風險大。併購案裡買賣雙方同日反向大幅波動，是判斷「市場覺得誰吃虧」最直接的指標。

movers.name: Itaú Unibanco（清單外）
movers.reason: 巴西選後金融股狂歡，拉丁美洲資產資金回流。與 XP 同向同日，佐證這是國家層級的資產重定價而非個股事件。

movers.name: Willis Towers Watson（清單外）
movers.reason: 當日 S&P 500 第二大漲幅。★ 誠實標註：具體催化事件未能取得確認，僅在當日漲幅榜上確認漲幅數字。列出是為了完整呈現異動榜，不要據此推論原因。

movers.reason: 多家券商調升目標價（RBC 升至 310 美元），看好臨床定序需求出現加速拐點、NovaSeq X 裝機動能強勁與高毛利耗材放量；近期納入 S&P 500 也帶來被動資金調倉買盤。

movers.name: Charles River Laboratories（清單外）
movers.reason: 公布 2030 年中長期成長目標，市場認為 CRO（委託研究機構）需求落底回升。生技與醫藥外包是 10/05 美股少數和 AI 無關卻仍大漲的族群。

movers.name: Western Digital（清單外 · 昨天的大跌主角，今天反彈）
movers.reason: ★ 這一檔是昨天晨報的續集：10/02 因東芝宣布 2027 財年 HDD 產能翻倍而重挫逾 10%，10/05 出現技術性超跌反彈 +6.34%。一天之內 −10% 再 +6%，說明那是情緒性的族群重定價而不是基本面確認——昨天把它標為「要搭配新聞區一起看」的那個判斷，今天得到了反面的佐證。

movers.name: 南亞（清單外 · 台股 · 創歷史新高）
movers.price: 10/05 收盤 286 元 · 漲停 · 成交逾 8.1 萬張
movers.reason: ★ 今天台股最值得知道的清單外標的。電子材料（CCL／銅箔基板／玻纖布）持續升級漲價，電子材料已占營收近六成，旗下南電與南亞科成為 AI 雙引擎，帶動整個塑膠類股單日彈逾 6%。為什麼對你重要：你的清單裡有台光電、金像電、華通這些**下游**的 CCL／PCB 廠，南亞是它們的**上游材料**。上游漲停代表這一輪漲價是從原材料端推上來的，而不是下游搶單——這種結構的持續性通常比較長，但也代表下游的毛利會被擠壓。

movers.name: C.H. Robinson（清單外 · 當日大跌）
movers.reason: 宣布以 58 億美元現金加股票收購 RXO 全球貨代業務，市場質疑併購代價與整合風險。買方跌 10.85%、賣方漲 22.54%，是典型的「市場不買單」併購反應。

movers.name: Lennar（清單外）
movers.reason: 遭空方研究報告狙擊，加上摩根士丹利調降評等；更結構性的原因是十年期美債殖利率升至 5.315%，為 2002 年 4 月以來最高收盤，直接打擊房市族群。房地產是當天 S&P 500 唯一收跌的類股。

movers.name: 聯電（清單外 · 台股 · 當日權值股最大跌幅）
movers.reason: ★ 10/05 正式敲定 18 億美元海外可轉債的轉換價與溢價（A 券轉換價 179.19 元／溢價 17.5%，B 券 202.06 元／溢價 32.5%，合計逾 550 億台幣）。兩個月內連續籌資，引發股權稀釋與資本支出效益的疑慮。在一個大盤漲 2.55% 的日子逆勢跌 5.57%，而且是財務面原因不是需求面——這種背離值得記下來。

market.disclaimer: 【已交叉確認、可以放心引用的數字】　台股 2026/10/05（一）收盤：加權指數 49,712.04（+1,236.30 點、+2.55%）、集中市場成交金額 1 兆 1,508 億元、盤中最高 49,770.66、三大法人買超 764 億元、台積電 2,575 元（+75 元、+3.00%，收盤與盤中同創歷史新高）、0050 115.95（+2.79%）、0056 57.85（+1.40%）——來源：鏡新聞、經濟日報 UDN、中央社、中時、鉅亨、ETtoday、HiStock、財報狗 TAIEX 頁。　美股 2026/10/05（一）收盤：那斯達克綜合 27,477.31（+286.45、+1.05%、歷史新高）、S&P 500 7,773.99（+51.27、+0.66%）、道瓊 51,267.90（+90.94、+0.18%）、羅素 2000 2,853.27（+20.38、+0.72%）、QQQ 756.20（+0.88%）、NVDA 238.90（+2.12%、盤中 240.10 創新高）、十年期美債殖利率 5.315%（+3.8bp、52 週新高）——來源：TheStreet 10/05 收盤報導、stockanalysis.com。　【需要注意的數字歧異，已逐一標明】①台積電收盤價：初步檢索出現「2,580 元」，但經濟日報、中央社、中時、鉅亨、ETtoday、新浪六個來源一致為 **2,575 元**，本報採用 2,575，2,580 研判為盤中價或誤植。②台股成交金額有兩種口徑：證交所／媒體的 11,508.04 億元為上市，財報狗頁面的 12,033.54 億元研判為上市＋上櫃合計，本報採用前者。③華邦電 2344 收盤價 HiStock 顯示 181.0、Wantgoo 顯示 179.0，漲跌幅採 +1.12%。　【標示為未取得、不要當精確數字引用的部分】WTW +17.10% 與 Moderna +6.95% 的具體催化原因未取得；部分台股漲停股（台燿 6274、聯茂 6213、燿華 2367、大眾控 3701、昇達科 3491、玉晶光 3406 等）僅確認「亮燈漲停」，未逐檔取得精確漲幅與收盤價；欣興 3037 當日漲跌幅未取得，卡片維持空狀態。　【這一區不是投資建議】觀察清單是分類整理，不是買賣建議；代號與報價請以下單平台最新資料為準。
